questions.question_english:
Given below are two statements: one is labelled as Assertion (A) and the other is labelled as Reason (R).
Assertion (A): Traditional inspection is increasingly being replaced by academic supervision in modern educational management.
Reason (R): Academic supervision focuses on professional growth, collaborative problem-solving, and pedagogical enhancement rather than mere fault-finding.
options_english: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
questions.explanation_english: The correct answer is (a). Modern educational governance has transitioned from traditional inspections—which were top-down, authoritarian, and focused narrowly on fault-finding and compliance checks—to academic supervision. Academic supervision is centered on pedagogical enhancement, mutual reflection, continuous professional development, and collegial problem-solving. Thus, Reason (R) directly explains why this paradigm shift in Assertion (A) has occurred.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (a) है। आधुनिक विद्यालय प्रबंधन में पारंपरिक 'निरीक्षण' प्रणाली (जो नौकरशाही, सत्तावादी और केवल त्रुटियाँ ढूँढने पर केंद्रित थी) के स्थान पर 'शैक्षणिक पर्यवेक्षण' को अपनाया गया है। पर्यवेक्षण का मूल उद्देश्य शिक्षकों का क्षमता निर्माण, सहयोगात्मक मार्गदर्शन और शिक्षण विधियों को परिष्कृत करना है। अतः अभिकथन (A) और कारण (R) दोनों सत्य हैं और R, A का सटीक कारण व व्याख्या प्रस्तुत करता है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (A) Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Modern school leadership shifts away from traditional, bureaucratic inspection toward supportive academic supervision. Conventional inspection focused narrowly on compliance checks and administrative fault-finding, creating anxiety. In contrast, academic supervision emphasizes continuous professional development, reflective dialogue, collaborative problem-solving, and pedagogy enhancement.

questions.question_english: An educational management system where virtually all policy decisions and administrative authority remain concentrated exclusively with the Principal, without delegating responsibilities to department heads or senior teachers, exemplifies which administrative model?
options_english: Centralisation
Decentralisation
Distributed Leadership
Democratic Supervision
questions.explanation_english: The correct answer is (a). Centralisation refers to an organizational structure where decision-making power, authority, and control are concentrated at the apex or single top level of hierarchy (in this case, the Principal). While this may provide uniform control, it suppresses teacher autonomy, stifles grassroots initiative, and slows down day-to-day administrative adaptability. Option (b), Decentralisation, involves dispersing decision-making powers down to lower operational levels and departments. Option (c), Distributed Leadership, treats leadership as a shared, collective practice distributed across multiple individuals and teams. Option (d), Democratic Supervision, emphasizes collaborative dialogue, consultation, and shared governance rather than authoritarian unilateralism.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (a) है। केंद्रीकरण (Centralisation) प्रबंधन की वह व्यवस्था है जिसमें निर्णय लेने, नीति निर्धारण करने और प्रशासनिक नियंत्रण का संपूर्ण अधिकार संगठन के सर्वोच्च स्तर (यहाँ प्रधानाचार्य) पर केंद्रित होता है। इसमें अधीनस्थ कर्मचारियों अथवा विभागाध्यक्षों को स्वायत्तता या अधिकार नहीं दिए जाते। विकल्प (b), विकेंद्रीकरण, निर्णय लेने के अधिकारों को निचले स्तरों और विभागों तक प्रसारित करने को संदर्भित करता है। विकल्प (c), वितरित नेतृत्व (Distributed Leadership), नेतृत्व को संस्था के विभिन्न सदस्यों और समूहों के बीच साझा करने की व्यवस्था है। विकल्प (d), लोकतांत्रिक पर्यवेक्षण, सहयोगात्मक निर्णय-प्रक्रिया और आपसी परामर्श पर आधारित होता है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (A) Centralisation

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Centralization occurs when decision-making authority, policy execution, and operational control remain strictly concentrated at the top administrative level of an organization. When a Principal retains all decision-making power without delegating tasks or consulting department heads, the leadership model operates centrally. This limits participative governance, reduces operational adaptability, and hinders professional autonomy across the faculty.

questions.question_english: Under government service rules, while financial incentives (like bonuses) are standardized, a Principal can utilize intrinsic motivation by:
options_english: Arbitrarily granting unauthorized extra paid casual leave days outside of standard government leave rules
Publicly recognizing teacher innovations and offering leadership roles
Completely ignoring their habitual late arrivals and unexcused absences during regular morning school hours
Directly providing them unmonitored cash bonuses disbursed from the official school development grant fund
questions.explanation_english: The correct answer is (b). In public sector educational administration, financial compensation and monetary perks are rigidly governed by civil service rules, leaving school heads with no discretionary authority over monetary bonuses. However, intrinsic motivation does not depend on financial payouts; it stems from fulfilling higher-order psychological needs such as competence, autonomy, and self-esteem. Principals effectively cultivate intrinsic motivation by publicly recognizing innovative pedagogy, praising dedication in institutional forums, assigning teachers to lead academic committees, and encouraging active participation in institutional planning. Options (a), (c), and (d) represent illegal practices that violate administrative conduct and financial rules.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (b) है। सरकारी सेवा नियमों के तहत वित्तीय भत्ते और बोनस पूर्व-निर्धारित होते हैं, जिनमें प्रधानाचार्य के पास वित्तीय प्रोत्साहन देने की कोई गुंजाइश नहीं होती। किंतु आंतरिक अभिप्रेरणा वित्तीय लाभों पर निर्भर नहीं होती, बल्कि यह स्वायत्तता, सक्षमता और आत्म-सम्मान जैसी उच्च-स्तरीय मनोवैज्ञानिक आवश्यकताओं से उत्पन्न होती है। एक कुशल प्रधानाचार्य शिक्षकों द्वारा किए गए शिक्षण नवाचारों की सार्वजनिक मंचों पर सराहना करके, उन्हें शैक्षणिक समितियों का नेतृत्व सौंपकर तथा संस्थागत योजनाओं में भागीदार बनाकर उनकी आंतरिक प्रेरणा को जागृत कर सकता है। विकल्प (a), (c) और (d) वित्तीय व सेवा आचार नियमों का गंभीर उल्लंघन हैं।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (B) Publicly recognizing teacher innovations and offering leadership roles

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Intrinsic motivation relies on fulfilling higher-order psychological needs, including autonomy, competence, and self-esteem. In public school administration where monetary incentives are rigidly standardized, school leaders effectively foster intrinsic motivation by publicly celebrating innovative teaching practices, delegating leadership responsibilities, and encouraging active involvement in institutional planning.

questions.question_english: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched regarding the classification of institutional school records?
options_english: Service Book – Academic Record
Scholar's Register – Equipment and Property Record
Stock Register – Personnel and Establishment Record
Cash Book – Financial Record
questions.explanation_english: The correct answer is (d). In school administration, records are categorized based on their functional domain. The Cash Book is an essential statutory financial record that meticulously tracks every monetary transaction, revenue receipt, and expenditure voucher on a daily basis. Option (a) is incorrectly paired because a Service Book is a personnel/establishment record documenting an employee's official service history, not an academic record. Option (b) is incorrectly paired because the Scholar's Register is a permanent student academic/enrolment record, not an equipment record. Option (c) is incorrectly paired because the Stock Register maintains inventory logs of physical assets, lab materials, and equipment, not personnel records.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (d) है। विद्यालयी अभिलेखों के वर्गीकरण में 'रोकड़ बही' (Cash Book) एक अनिवार्य वैधानिक वित्तीय अभिलेख है, जिसमें विद्यालय के समस्त दैनिक वित्तीय लेन-देन, प्राप्तियों और व्ययों का विधिवत लेखा-जोखा रखा जाता है। विकल्प (a) गलत है क्योंकि सेवा पुस्तिका (Service Book) कर्मचारी का व्यक्तिगत/कार्मिक अभिलेख होती है, न कि शैक्षणिक। विकल्प (b) गलत है क्योंकि स्कॉलर्स रजिस्टर विद्यार्थियों के प्रवेश, उपस्थिति और शैक्षणिक इतिहास का स्थायी अभिलेख है, न कि उपस्कर का। विकल्प (c) गलत है क्योंकि स्टॉक रजिस्टर विद्यालय की भौतिक सामग्री, फर्नीचर और उपकरणों का भंडार अभिलेख होता है, न कि कार्मिकों का।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (D) Cash Book – Financial Record

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Accurate record-keeping is vital for administrative propriety and regulatory compliance. A Cash Book is a primary financial register documenting all daily financial transactions, receipts, disbursements, and fund balances. Proper maintenance of the cash book ensures financial transparency, enables statutory audits, prevents monetary misappropriation, and upholds institutional fiscal accountability within educational administration.

questions.question_english: While 'school climate' refers to the short-term, malleable feeling and atmosphere of a school, 'school culture' is best defined as:
options_english: The architectural physical infrastructure, layout, and concrete structural design of campus school buildings
The deeply ingrained values, shared beliefs, and historical traditions of the school community
Daily environmental weather conditions directly affecting morning student attendance and staff punctuality
The aggregated statistical end-of-year examination pass percentage recorded across all academic subjects
questions.explanation_english: In organizational theory, school climate represents the immediate, malleable psychological atmosphere and current morale (the organization's 'weather'), whereas school culture represents the deeply embedded values, unwritten rules, shared beliefs, and historical traditions that evolve slowly over time (the organization's 'personality'). Culture forms the enduring identity and foundational philosophy of the school. Option A refers to physical facilities, Option C refers to literal meteorology, and Option D refers to academic performance metrics.
questions.explanation_hindi: संगठनात्मक सिद्धांत के अनुसार, 'विद्यालयी परिवेश' (School Climate) तात्कालिक मनोदशा और वातावरण को दर्शाता है जिसे अल्पकाल में बदला जा सकता है, जबकि 'विद्यालयी संस्कृति' (School Culture) संस्था के अंतर्निहित मूल्यों, ऐतिहासिक परंपराओं, साझा विश्वासों और अघोषित कार्य-संस्कृतियों का समुच्चय होती है। यह संस्थागत पहचान का निर्माण करती है और दीर्घकाल में विकसित होती है। अतः विकल्प B सही उत्तर है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (B) Deeply ingrained values, beliefs, and traditions of the school community

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: School culture represents the deeply embedded values, shared beliefs, unwritten rules, and historical traditions that shape how an institution functions over time. Unlike school climate, which is relatively fluid and responsive to immediate situational changes, school culture evolves slowly, serving as the foundational identity of the school community.

questions.question_english: Identify the correctly matched pair concerning teacher appraisal and professional development:
options_english: Self-Appraisal – The teacher evaluates their own performance against set goals and professional standards
Formative Appraisal – Annual Performance Appraisal Report (APAR) utilized for promotional decisions
Summative Appraisal – Continuous diagnostic feedback provided during the term strictly for instructional improvement
360-Degree Appraisal – Appraisal conducted exclusively and unilaterally by the Directorate of Education
questions.explanation_english: Pair A is correct: self-appraisal is a structured reflective exercise enabling teachers to independently examine their pedagogical accomplishments, instructional challenges, and personal growth targets. Pair B is incorrect because an APAR used for promotional decisions is a summative evaluation. Pair C is incorrect because ongoing feedback during the term for continuous improvement is formative. Pair D is incorrect because a 360-degree appraisal gathers multi-source feedback from peers, students, supervisors, and subordinates, rather than being an exclusive top-down review by a Directorate.
questions.explanation_hindi: स्व-मूल्यांकन (Self-Appraisal) एक आत्म-चिंतनशील प्रक्रिया है जिसमें शिक्षक स्वयं अपने शिक्षण, उपलब्धियों और कमियों का वस्तुनिष्ठ मूल्यांकन करते हैं, अतः युग्म A सही सुमेलित है। विकल्प B गलत है क्योंकि पदोन्नति हेतु उपयोग की जाने वाली APAR योगात्मक (Summative) मूल्यांकन का रूप है। विकल्प C गलत है क्योंकि सत्र के दौरान सुधार हेतु दी जाने वाली प्रतिपुष्टि रचनात्मक (Formative) मूल्यांकन कहलाती है। विकल्प D गलत है क्योंकि 360-डिग्री मूल्यांकन बहु-स्रोतीय होता है जिसमें सहकर्मी, विद्यार्थी, अभिभावक और पर्यवेक्षक सभी शामिल होते हैं। अतः विकल्प A सही उत्तर है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (A) Self-Appraisal – The teacher evaluates their own performance against set goals

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Self-appraisal is an essential reflective component of professional staff development. It allows educators to systematically evaluate their teaching effectiveness, assess target achievement, identify personal strengths and weaknesses, and formulate individual growth goals. questions.question_english: According to Victor Vroom’s Expectancy Theory, how can a Principal best motivate a teacher to take up the role of an Examination Incharge?

By fulfilling lower-level basic job security and safety needs through promises of permanent tenure retention
By appealing directly to their inherent Theory X traits through strict supervisory oversight and tight control
questions.explanation_english: The correct answer is (b). Victor Vroom’s Expectancy Theory posits that motivation is a multiplicative function of Expectancy, Instrumentality, and Valence. To motivate a teacher to accept the arduous role of Examination Incharge, the Principal must align all three elements: (1) Expectancy: Ensure the teacher feels capable of managing the task by offering adequate resources, training, and support; (2) Instrumentality: Establish high trust that successful execution of the role will lead to formal organizational recognition and rewards; (3) Valence: Ensure the offered rewards (e.g., commendations, professional prestige, leadership growth) are personally valued by the teacher. Options (a) and (d) describe coercive, authoritarian methods that demotivate. Option (c) relates to Maslow's theory.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (b) है। विक्टर व्रूम के प्रत्याशा सिद्धांत के अनुसार, अभिप्रेरणा तीन घटकों पर निर्भर करती है: प्रत्याशा (प्रयास से निष्पादन संभव होने का विश्वास), साधनता (सफल निष्पादन पर प्रतिफल मिलने का विश्वास), और संयोजकता (मिलने वाले प्रतिफल का व्यक्तिगत मूल्य)। इन तीनों तत्वों का प्रभावी समन्वय करके प्रधानाचार्य शिक्षक को आश्वस्त करता है कि आवश्यक सहयोग से वह इस पद को संभाल सकता है (प्रत्याशा), उसके अच्छे काम को संस्थागत पहचान मिलेगी (साधनता), और यह पहचान उसके करियर के लिए मूल्यवान होगी (संयोजकता)। विकल्प (a) और (d) सत्तावादी व दंडात्मक तरीके हैं जो विरोध उत्पन्न करते हैं। विकल्प (c) मैस्लो के सिद्धांत से संबंधित है।

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Vroom’s Expectancy Theory posits that motivation depends on three factors: Expectancy (confidence that effort yields performance), Instrumentality (trust that performance yields a reward), and Valence (valuing the reward). questions.question_english: The foundational premise underlying Contingency Theories of leadership is that:
options_english: There exists one universally superior administrative leadership style that guarantees success across all organizational contexts
Leadership effectiveness depends on matching leader style with situational demands
Effective leaders are born with fixed specific personality traits that guarantee success regardless of external environment
Subordinates exclusively dictate and determine the precise organizational leadership style required from administrative leaders at all times
questions.explanation_english: The correct answer is (b). Contingency theories of leadership (such as Fiedler's Contingency Model, House's Path-Goal Theory, and Hersey and Blanchard's Situational Leadership Model) postulate that no single leadership style is universally optimal. Instead, administrative success depends on the match or fit between the leader's behavior and specific situational variables—such as task complexity, organizational climate, positional power, and subordinate competence and commitment. Option (a) reflects early classical management's search for 'one best way', which contingency theory disproves. Option (c) describes Trait Theory. Option (d) incorrectly asserts that subordinates unilaterally determine the leader's style.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (b) है। नेतृत्व के आकस्मिकता (कंटींजेन्सी) सिद्धांतों का मूल आधार यह है कि कोई भी एकल प्रशासनिक शैली सभी परिस्थितियों में सार्वभौमिक रूप से सफल नहीं हो सकती। नेता की प्रभावशीलता इस बात पर निर्भर करती है कि नेता का दृष्टिकोण और व्यवहार विशिष्ट परिस्थितिजन्य चरों—जैसे कार्य की जटिलता, संगठनात्मक वातावरण, नेता की प्राधिकार शक्ति और अधीनस्थों की योग्यता व तत्परता—के साथ कितना सुमेलित है। विकल्प (a) प्रारंभिक प्रबंधन सिद्धांतों की 'एक सर्वश्रेष्ठ मार्ग' की धारणा को दर्शाता है जिसे आकस्मिकता सिद्धांत खारिज करता है। विकल्प (c) शीलगुण सिद्धांत (ट्रेइट थ्योरी) से संबंधित है। विकल्प (d) यह गलत दावा करता है कि केवल अधीनस्थ ही नेतृत्व शैली का एकतरफा निर्धारण करते हैं।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (B) Leadership effectiveness depends on matching leader style with situational demands.

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Contingency theories of leadership state that administrative success does not rely on a single, universally applicable style. questions.explanation_english: The correct answer is (d). The Deming Cycle or PDCA cycle stands for Plan, Do, Check, Act. It is an iterative four-step management framework for continuous quality improvement: (1) Plan – identify goals, analyze root problems, and develop improvement strategies; (2) Do – execute the plan on a small or pilot scale; (3) Check – measure, analyze, and evaluate outcomes against benchmark targets; and (4) Act – institutionalize and standardize successful practices or revise procedures if results are suboptimal. questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (d) है। सम्पूर्ण गुणवत्ता प्रबंधन में पीडीसीए (PDCA) चक्र का तात्पर्य 'Plan, Do, Check, Act' (योजना बनाएं, क्रियान्वयन करें, जाँचें, कार्य/सुधार करें) से है। इसे एडवर्ड्स डेमिंग ने निरंतर गुणवत्ता संवर्धन के लिए एक चक्रीय ढाँचे के रूप में प्रतिपादित किया था: (1) Plan (योजना) – समस्याओं की पहचान और कार्ययोजना बनाना; (2) Do (क्रियान्वयन) – योजना को प्रायोगिक स्तर पर लागू करना; (3) Check (जाँच) – परिणामों का मूल्यांकन व विश्लेषण करना; और (4) Act (सुधार/मानकीकरण) – सफल परिवर्तनों को स्थायी बनाना तथा आवश्यक सुधार करना।

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: The PDCA cycle, popularized by quality management expert W. Edwards Deming, represents a continuous four-step framework for process optimization. Organizations Plan by establishing objectives, Do by implementing changes on a test scale, Check by measuring results against expectations, and Act by standardizing successful improvements or refining methods to ensure continuous quality enhancement.

questions.explanation_english: The correct answer is (c). In the Thomas-Kilmann Conflict Mode Instrument, Collaborating represents a conflict style characterized by high assertiveness and high cooperativeness, designed to achieve a mutually beneficial 'win-win' outcome. Instead of forcing one party to capitulate (competing) or having both make painful concessions (compromising), the Principal brings the conflicting department heads together in transparent, problem-solving dialogue. By uncovering underlying priorities and crafting an integrative resource solution that satisfies the core requirements of both departments, the Principal effectively employs the Collaborating style.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (c) है। थॉमस-किलमैन संघर्ष समाधान मॉडल के अनुसार, 'सहयोग' (कोलेबोरेटिंग) उच्च दृढ़ता और उच्च सहयोगात्मकता पर आधारित एक आदर्श 'जीत-जीत' (विन-विन) शैली है। इसमें किसी एक विभाग के हितों को दबाने (कंपीटिंग) या दोनों को घाटा सहने के लिए विवश करने (कॉम्प्रोमाइजिंग) के बजाय दोनों विभागाध्यक्षों के साथ रचनात्मक संवाद किया जाता है। एक ऐसा एकीकृत समाधान तैयार किया जाता है जिससे दोनों विभागों की मुख्य शैक्षणिक ज़रूरतें पूरी हो जाएं। अतः प्रधानाचार्य द्वारा यहाँ 'सहयोगात्मक शैली' का उपयोग किया गया है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (C) Collaborating (Win-Win)

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Collaborating is a high-assertiveness, high-cooperativeness conflict management style aimed at achieving win-win outcomes. By engaging both department heads in transparent dialogue to identify underlying needs without forcing sacrifices, the administrator crafts an integrative solution, satisfying both parties while preserving professional relationships and institutional budget goals.

questions.explanation_english: The correct answer is (c). In the classical administrative framework POSDCORB developed by Luther Gulick and Lyndall Urwick, the functional acronym represents seven key executive duties: Planning (P), Organizing (O), Staffing (S), Directing (D), Coordinating (CO), Reporting (R), and Budgeting (B). questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (c) है। लूथर गुलिक और लिंडाल उर्विक द्वारा दिए गए 'पॉसडकॉर्ब' (POSDCORB) प्रारूप में प्रत्येक अक्षर मुख्य कार्यकारी कार्यों का प्रतिनिधित्व करता है: P (नियोजन - Planning), O (संगठन - Organizing), S (कर्मचारी व्यवस्था - Staffing), D (निर्देशन - Directing), CO (समन्वय - Coordinating), R (रिपोर्टिंग / प्रतिवेदन - Reporting), और B (बजट निर्माण - Budgeting)। अतः यहाँ 'R' का अर्थ 'रिपोर्टिंग' (प्रतिवेदन देना) है, जिसके तहत अभिलेखों, निरीक्षणों और नियमित रिपोर्टों के माध्यम से उच्चाधिकारियों व हितधारकों को कार्य-प्रगति से अवगत कराया जाता है। विकल्प (a) गलत है क्योंकि भर्ती स्टाफिंग का अंग है। विकल्प (b) और (d) पॉसडकॉर्ब के घटक नहीं हैं।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (C) Reporting

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: The classical administrative framework POSDCORB synthesizes core executive functions into a functional acronym. questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (a) है। सुधारात्मक पर्यवेक्षण (Corrective Supervision) विद्यालय प्रबंधन का एक पारंपरिक दृष्टिकोण है जो मुख्य रूप से शिक्षकों की गलतियों को पकड़ने, कमियाँ निकालने और संस्थागत नियमों के कठोर अनुपालन को लागू करने पर केंद्रित होता है। यह दृष्टिकोण शिक्षकों में व्यावसायिक संवर्धन के स्थान पर भय और असुरक्षा की भावना उत्पन्न करता है। विकल्प (b) गलत है क्योंकि स्वाट (SWOT) विश्लेषण स्वयं संस्था की आंतरिक शक्तियों और कमजोरियों तथा बाह्य अवसरों और चुनौतियों का समग्र रणनीतिक विश्लेषण है, न कि केवल प्रतिस्पर्धियों के भौतिक ढाँचे का। विकल्प (c) गलत है क्योंकि सम्पूर्ण गुणवत्ता प्रबंधन (TQM) केवल अंतिम परीक्षा परिणामों पर नहीं, अपितु संपूर्ण संगठनात्मक प्रक्रियाओं के निरंतर सुधार (Kaizen) और सभी हितधारकों की सहभागिता पर बल देता है। विकल्प (d) गलत है क्योंकि मेंटरिंग (मार्गदर्शन) एक दीर्घकालिक, गैर-दंडात्मक और विकासात्मक सहयोग प्रक्रिया है, न कि बाह्य परीक्षकों द्वारा किया जाने वाला अल्पकालिक मूल्यांकन।

questions.question_english: In the Hersey-Blanchard Situational Leadership Model, a 'Telling' (high task orientation, low relationship orientation) leadership style is most appropriate for subordinates who are:
options_english: Highly competent (able) and highly motivated (willing) across assigned institutional tasks
Fully competent (able) but unmotivated or hesitant (unwilling) to undertake independent action
Unable and unwilling (or insecure)
Lacking operational competence (unable) but enthusiastic and motivated (willing)
questions.explanation_english: The correct answer is (c). In Hersey and Blanchard's Situational Leadership Model, follower readiness is classified into four maturity levels (M1 to M4). Subordinates at M1 (lowest maturity) are both unable (lack competence/skills) and unwilling or insecure (lack motivation/confidence). For M1 followers, a 'Telling' (directing) style—characterized by high task direction and low relationship focus—is required to provide explicit instructions, rigid structuring, and close supervision.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (c) है। हर्सी और ब्लैंचर्ड के परिस्थितिजन्य नेतृत्व मॉडल में, अनुयायियों की परिपक्वता को चार स्तरों (M1 से M4) में बाँटा गया है। M1 स्तर के अधीनस्थ वे होते हैं जो कार्य करने में 'अक्षम' (Unable - कौशल की कमी) तथा 'अनिच्छुक या असुरक्षित' (Unwilling/Insecure - आत्मविश्वास व प्रेरणा की कमी) होते हैं। ऐसे कर्मचारियों के लिए 'निर्देशात्मक/बताना' (Telling - S1) शैली सर्वाधिक उपयुक्त होती है, जिसमें नेता स्पष्ट दिशा-निर्देश और निकट पर्यवेक्षण प्रदान करता है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (C) Unable and unwilling

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: In the Hersey-Blanchard Situational Leadership Theory, the ‘Telling’ style provides high task guidance and low relational support. This directive approach is tailored for followers at the lowest readiness level (M1), who lack job competence (unable) and display low commitment or confidence (unwilling), requiring clear instructions and direct oversight.

questions.question_english: In administrative decision-making theory, 'Programmed Decisions' within school governance are best described as those that:
options_english: Tackle highly unprecedented, unstructured, and novel strategic challenges
Are repetitive and routine in nature, governed by established rules, regulations, and standard operating procedures
Focus exclusively on long-term institutional expansion and capital infrastructure development
Are formulated exclusively by central ministry bureaucrats without institutional delegation
questions.explanation_english: The correct answer is (b). In Herbert Simon’s decision-making taxonomy, 'Programmed Decisions' are repetitive, routine, and structured decisions handled through established administrative rules, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and institutional regulations (e.g., processing student admissions as per merit lists, sanctioning leave under civil service rules, scheduled examination logistics). Option (a) describes non-programmed decisions, which require creative, custom problem-solving for novel, ill-structured dilemmas. Option (c) relates to strategic, non-programmed long-term planning decisions. Option (d) confuses the hierarchical level of decision-making with its structured nature.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (b) है। हर्बर्ट साइमन के निर्णय-निर्माण वर्गीकरण के अनुसार, 'प्रोग्राम्ड' (क्रमादेशित या नेमी) निर्णय वे होते हैं जो दोहरावदार और नियमित प्रकृति के होते हैं तथा जिनके निस्तारण के लिए पहले से ही नियम, नीतियां और मानक संचालन प्रक्रियाएं (SOPs) निर्धारित होती हैं (जैसे- नियमों के अनुसार अवकाश स्वीकृत करना, मेरिट के आधार पर प्रवेश देना)। विकल्प (a) 'गैर-प्रोग्राम्ड' (Non-programmed) निर्णयों की विशेषता है जो जटिल और अभूतपूर्व समस्याओं से संबंधित होते हैं। विकल्प (c) दीर्घकालिक रणनीतिक निर्णयों को दर्शाता है। विकल्प (d) निर्णय-प्रक्रिया के स्तर की भ्रामक व्याख्या करता है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (B) Are repetitive, routine, and guided by established policies

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Programmed decisions address routine, recurring organizational situations governed by pre-established rules, standardized operating procedures, and institutional policies. Because these problems occur frequently, administrative responses are structured, predictable, and systematic, eliminating the need to develop novel decision-making procedures every time the situation arises, thereby streamlining routine administrative tasks across school operations.

questions.question_english: Which of the following statements distinguishing Transactional from Transformational leadership is incorrect?
options_english: Transformational leaders focus exclusively on short-term routine operational tasks
Transactional leadership relies heavily on contingent rewards and management by exception across operational routines
Transformational leadership systematically seeks to transform organizational culture while inspiring follower dedication
Transactional leadership focuses primarily on maintaining the status quo and securing predictable routine performance
questions.explanation_english: The correct answer is (a). Transactional leaders focus on short-term tasks, routine operations, standard operating procedures, and contractual exchanges (contingent rewards). In stark contrast, Transformational leaders transcend routine day-to-day operations to focus on long-term vision, institutional change, inspiration, and personal empowerment. Therefore, asserting that transformational leaders focus only on short-term tasks is completely incorrect.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (a) है। संव्यवहारात्मक (ट्रांजेक्शनल) नेता अल्पकालिक लक्ष्यों, दैनिक कार्यों और संविदात्मक पुरस्कारों पर ध्यान केंद्रित करते हैं; जबकि रूपांतरणकारी (ट्रांसफॉर्मेशनल) नेता दूरगामी दृष्टिकोण, नवाचार, संस्थागत बदलाव और अनुयायियों के आंतरिक उत्थान पर काम करते हैं। अतः यह कहना कि 'रूपांतरणकारी नेता केवल अल्पकालिक दैनिक कार्यों पर ध्यान केंद्रित करते हैं' पूरी तरह असत्य और त्रुटिपूर्ण है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (A) Transformational leaders focus only on short-term tasks.

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Transactional leadership focuses on short-term tasks, routine operations, and contingent reward structures. In contrast, transformational leadership focuses on long-term vision, organizational innovation, and inspiring followers to exceed standard performance expectations. Claiming that transformational leaders focus only on short-term tasks misrepresents the core tenets of transformational leadership theory.
